steps.text: The Year 937
Duke Erik and Professor Lierland D. of Piesberg Parliamentary University published this co-authored paper in The Journal of Urban History ('Where Did We Come From?' Issue 44).
The paper discussed the results of a detailed analysis of a collection of weathered remains.
The investigation into Sargon Excavation Site 4 revealed a common origin for Infected quarantines and executions with the law itself.
That is to say, the suffering of the Infected predates even the emergence of the law.
Lungmen, Support Structure Level, Exit

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Now, we must fight.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If you can defeat me, it means some will be able to survive——

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I am willing to join Rhodes Island. I am willing to fight together with you against the enemies of the Infected, your way.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: This is my burden to bear.
8:50 A.M. - Four hours after the recapture of L. G. D. Headquarters - Near the Commandery Exit
L. G. D. and Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals
Lungmen Search-and-Destroy Campaign - Final Phase
1. Control Reunion's movements within Lungmen. Complete under the direction of the L. G. D.
2. Mop up Reunion's forces still in Lungmen. Complete under the direction of the L. G. D.
3. Eliminate Reunion's operational commander, or their command influence. Complete under the direction of the L. G. D.
4. Eliminate the Reunion Movement before they can withdraw to the slums. Complete under a joint L. G. D. and Rhodes Island operation.
'...Attention all citizens... are performing an evacuation exercise...'
'...Those citizens who have failed to evacuate, please lock your doors, draw your curtains, and do not leave your homes...'
Does it have to be so loud?
Shoot that drone down already!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Now we're just caught up in an exercise? How dare they use such cheap tricks to cover up the exquisite terror I've worked so hard to formulate?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: And to repeat it over and over again in both Lungmen and Ursine tongues!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: I've had enough of these drones. Get! Hurry! Keep to the side streets!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Nothing from Scout Team 3 either!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Assault's signal suddenly c- cut out...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We're losing contact with all our overwatch teams one by one!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Why! How!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Such an insult... such humiliation foisted upon our movement!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But how, and why? Damn you, Lungmen! Damn the Lungmenites! Damn the uninfected!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: (I've never seen him so unstable like this.)

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: (Faust, do we still have a chance to retreat?)

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: (I'll make some space for you.)

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: (If it's just your run-of-the-mill cops with the L. G. D. plus Rhodes Island, we should be able to get away.)

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: (What do you mean? Who else could be out there?)

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Agh...! I can't believe this! I can't get through!!

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: If I can't even issue orders to my teams, how am I supposed to win?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: (Someone is watching us. There is still more to this city.)

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: (Get ready. To survive.)

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: (Got it.)

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: (...Faust.)

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: (Hm?)

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: (We trust you.)
9:20 A.M. - Rhodes Island patrol route near the L. G. D.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: They're really leaving this to the Infected? Rhodes Island got a raw deal this time.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: And in Lungmen! Hmph. How could a city as big as Lungmen not have what it takes to fight off an invasion on its own?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Now they've got Infected fighting Infected on behalf of the normies...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Whatever. It's certainly not the first time.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Hurry up and clear a path! Don't look back, just break through their defenses!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: If we can just get across this street, we have a shot at grouping up with the second brigade!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Don't give them a chance to return fire. There aren't many of us left——
And in a moment, there won't be any of you left.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Wh... who are you? Did you just drop out of the sky?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Get back, get out of here! She... she might be able to fly!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...I really can't!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Identify yourself!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Use your scanner!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Sorry, I have to deal with this first!)

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Lungmen law enforcement, listen up! I am from Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hold your fire. I really don't want to have to deal with crossfire while I'm fighting.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I can handle this on my own. You head on to the next roadblock.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Okay then. Back to you guys.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What's up with this chick?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'll explain it to you. I'm sure you can figure it out. Probably.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I am Blaze, one of Rhodes Island's elite operators. My current objective is to cripple your combat capabilities.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The intentions with which you undertook this invasion of a foreign city-state notwithstanding, we aim chiefly to disarm you.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Setting aside the injuries and damages you have inflicted upon others, and attendant penalties, any attempt to resist at this point is pointless. Put down your weapons. You still have a chance.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Huh? What? You...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: My fellow Infected, I give you a choice:

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Surrender at once, and I will escort you to Rhodes Island, and subsequently deposit you somewhere welcoming to Infected.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: She blocked it with her bare hands?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Seeing as how you continue to resist, there's nothing more I can say.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: As if we'd just let you lock us up? How crazy are you?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm not crazy! There's a time and a place for fight, and a time and a place for flight.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's just that when you choose to fight, all I can do is fight back.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Either way, I don't need my chainsaw.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sorry, I really don't want to fight my fellow Infected.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...it's so humid in Lungmen.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: This stupid cat... is using Arts! Her body's steaming up!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: My body? Guess again. Is it the air around me that's getting hot, or the air around you?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Let's take a Sami bath together. My treat.
